svg.text: SeedForge R3.1 core cell - plywood drilling template 1:1

Base 380 x 507 mm. Outlines = part footprints at the base; red = holes (diameter in mm, CAD; all 2.4 mm = M2 wood screws), centre-punch at the crosses. Generated by tools/build_drilling_template.py. CAD-derived: measure before final fabrication.
